home_faq_what_q: What does Tiny Desk AI Generator create?
home_faq_what_a: {name} puts selected faces into the Outstanding band performance. You assign a photo to lead vocals, sax, keys or either backing singer, and the model edits those roles through the clip. The service uses a preset performance rather than asking you to write a video prompt.
home_faq_people_q: Can I replace just one performer, or all five?
home_faq_people_a: Either works. There are five roles: lead, sax, keys and two backing singers. Replacing one role costs the same per video as replacing five. The stage starts with five dogs; a dog left in place stays in the cast, while removing it keeps the original performer.
home_faq_cost_q: What do the credit packs cost, and do they renew?
home_faq_cost_a: Current packs are {plans}. These are one-time purchases, not recurring plans. Credits do not expire. Choose the number of videos you want; using more faces in a single video does not increase its credit cost.
home_faq_free_q: Can I try the generator without buying credits?
home_faq_free_a: You can watch the examples and select your photos before checkout. Rendering a new video requires paid credits; there is no free render or generation trial. If a render fails, the credits used for it return automatically.
home_faq_model_q: Which model handles the face replacement?
home_faq_model_a: The current workflow uses Kuaishou Kling 4.0 in video-edit mode at {resolution}. It processes the reference clip and selected photos together; you do not need to create a separate prompt or edit every shot yourself.
home_faq_time_q: Do I need to keep the page open while it renders?
home_faq_time_a: No. A render usually takes about 7–10 minutes, though provider queues can make it longer. You can close the page and return using the same account to check progress or download the finished result.
home_faq_format_q: What length, size and file type will I receive?
home_faq_format_a: The output is approximately 18 seconds long: a vertical 9:16 MP4 at {resolution}, without an added site watermark. It follows the band shot, lead close-up, sax section and final band shot of the reference performance.
home_faq_song_q: Why are there downloads with audio and without audio?
home_faq_song_a: The main download has the Outstanding reference soundtrack mixed in. A separate silent copy gives you another option if a social platform mutes that track: upload the silent file and, where permitted, select Outstanding from the platform’s own audio library.
home_faq_capcut_q: Do I have to use CapCut or download a template?
home_faq_capcut_a: No editing app or template download is required. The reference performance and generation instructions are already configured. Assign your photos, confirm the parody checkbox and start the render from this page.
home_faq_photo_q: Which face photo is most likely to work well?
home_faq_photo_a: Choose a well-lit, front-facing image with one clear adult face. Keep the eyes, nose and mouth unobstructed. A group photo, sunglasses, a strong beauty filter or a cartoon makes the replacement less reliable. Use a separate clear image for each role you want to change.
home_faq_celebrity_q: Can the cast include a coach, player or celebrity?
home_faq_celebrity_a: The service allows obvious parody involving adult public figures, including coaches, players and celebrities, as well as friends or yourself. Do not upload a private person who would not agree, depict anyone under 18, imply a genuine endorsement or use the result to sell something. The provider may refuse a request; a refused video returns its credits.
home_faq_real_q: Are the coach videos genuine concert appearances?
home_faq_real_a: No. The replaced faces are AI edits of the Charlie Wilson Tiny Desk performance, not evidence that those coaches or players performed at NPR. A card labelled as a trend reference illustrates the format and is not a claim that the video was made on this website.
home_faq_post_q: What should I know before posting to TikTok or Instagram?
home_faq_post_a: Use the result as a personal, non-commercial parody, make its AI-edited nature clear and follow the platform’s rules. Do not present it as a real appearance or an endorsement. We cannot license the source music to you, and a platform may mute or remove a post.
home_faq_fail_q: Will I receive credits or money back if something goes wrong?
home_faq_fail_a: A failed render returns the credits spent on that video automatically. For a completed result with a clear technical fault, email support within 7 days with its link; we return the credits or refund that video. A refund of a completely unused pack is available within 14 days. Ordinary differences in AI likeness are not automatically a technical defect.
home_faq_photos_q: How long do you keep the face photos I upload?
home_faq_photos_a: Uploaded photos are used for your requested video and sent to the AI provider for that processing. They are deleted from our own storage within 2 days. Completed videos have a separate retention rule and remain in your account until you request deletion. The privacy page also explains the stage information saved in your browser.
home_faq_npr_q: Who operates this site—is it an official Tiny Desk service?
home_faq_npr_a: {name} operates at tinydeskaigenerator.org as an independent parody-video tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by NPR, Tiny Desk Concerts, Charlie Wilson or The Gap Band. Tiny Desk is a trademark of NPR.

home_faq_controls_q: How do I restore a dog or keep the original performer?
home_faq_controls_a: On a photo you uploaded, × restores that role’s default dog. On a dog, × removes the replacement so the original performer stays in the video. Tap the face to choose another photo. Review every role before pressing Make.
home_faq_move_q: Can I move an uploaded face to a different role?
home_faq_move_a: Yes. Drag an assigned photo onto another face slot. Dropping onto an empty role moves it; dropping onto a filled role swaps the assignments. On a computer, you can also drop an image file straight onto a role.
home_faq_phone_q: My photos are on my phone. Do I need to email them to myself?
home_faq_phone_a: No. On a computer, open “Photos on your phone? Scan to upload” beneath the stage and scan its QR code with your phone. Selected photos are sent to that stage. Keep the phone upload page open if you want to send more; if the code expires, create a new one.
